verdict.rationale: Kong is an API/AI gateway that routes, secures, and governs traffic (including MCP and multi-LLM traffic) and provides APIOps tooling (decK) for declarative config automation, but nothing in the evidence shows a capability for setting up autonomous background automations/agents that run independently over time — decK and Inso CLI are CI/CD-triggered sync/test tools, not self-running background agents. The axis is plausible for a product positioned around 'AI agent infrastructure' (kong-docs-3, kong-docs-22) but no concrete feature demonstrates autonomous background execution.
